answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on five (English) tasks commonly used to evaluate pre-trained language models: question answering (SQuAD v1.1 Rajpurkar et al., 2016) and (SQuAD v2), natural language inference (MNLI), sentence similarity (QQP), sentiment classification (SST-2) and abstractive summarization.

answer_2.quote: We report the performance on the development set as measured by the accuracy for MNLI and SST-2, F1 for QQP, the exact match (EM) and F1 for SQuAD and ROUGE for CNN/DailyMail.
